competitors.name: Maison Yusif
competitors.why_competitor: Best-known Ghanaian niche fragrance house; sells direct in GHS with stores in Accra and Kumasi and a long-lasting promise.

hero_product.name: Scent of a Queen (Extrait de Parfum)
hero_product.source: https://maisonyusif.com/shop/women/scent-of-a-queen/?wcpbc-manual-country=GH (range GHS 650-1,350 for 30-100ml; USD view shows 100ml at $135), seen 2026-11-25

competitors.current_offer: Pre-order 'save $10' on Scent of a Queen, The Vatican and The Apex (stock due December 2026); 'Unlocked Complimentary Shipping' cart banner, no threshold stated.
strengths: Largest social following of any Ghanaian fragrance house
Three stores (Kokomlemle and East Legon in Accra, Asokwa in Kumasi) and 48-hour delivery within Ghana
Steady national and international press
Scent finder quiz and verified-purchase reviews
Size ladder from 30ml to 100ml
weaknesses: Hero women's scent and other bestsellers out of stock on pre-order
Only three of 25 products are women's scents
Returns only within 48 hours, unopened
Awards and sales claims come mainly from the brand's own press releases
Discovery set sold out

competitors.name: Scent of Africa
competitors.why_competitor: Premium made-in-Ghana fine fragrance house, widely stocked in Accra malls, perfumeries and airport duty-free.

hero_product.name: Nefee Eau de Parfum
hero_product.source: Retailer price at https://scentopia.com/products/soa-nefee-edp (100ml GHS 1,952), seen 2026-11-25; brand site shows no reliable price

competitors.current_offer: None on the brand site. Scentopia shows a sitewide 'promotions up to 50% off' banner; inclusion of Scent of Africa not confirmed.
strengths: Distribution through Scentopia, luxury perfumeries and Kotoka airport, plus 16 countries
Polished packaging and African-legend storytelling with design awards
New vanilla women's scent (Assaye, June 2026)
weaknesses: Highest price per ml of the five
Dated brand site with no shipping information and an implausible GHC 75 price
No reviews, samples or quiz
Low posting volume for its age

competitors.name: Hareem Istanbul (Ghana)
competitors.origin: Turkey (Istanbul); Ghana site and store in Accra
competitors.why_competitor: Single-brand house with a Ghana store, GHS pricing and the price point closest to Beguile; women's and oud lines.
competitors.current_offer: None running; newsletter promises private offers.
strengths: Lowest 100ml price of the five
GHS pricing with card, Mobile Money and bank transfer
Walk-in store and free pickup at Marina Mall, Spintex
Scent finder quiz and wide gifting range
weaknesses: Small Ghana following
Catalogue led by home fragrance rather than fine fragrance
No customer reviews seen
Delivery fee unknown until paid to the rider

competitors.name: Sanhwe
competitors.why_competitor: Ghanaian perfume-oil brand with vanilla, musk and oud scents; the local alternative to Beguile's oils.

hero_product.name: ANIGYE
hero_product.source: Store product feed https://sanhwe.com/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products (3ml GHS 120 to 50ml GHS 780), seen 2026-11-25; storefront itself under maintenance

competitors.current_offer: 5% off for newsletter sign-up; complimentary treats on orders above GHS 680; White Pulse pre-order from 1 December 2026.
strengths: Twi naming and local story
Entry price from GHS 120 for 3ml
Oils in vanilla, musk and oud families
New Heartbeat Collection about to launch
weaknesses: Website under maintenance; orders by WhatsApp
Very small audience
High price per ml for a little-known name
Shipping terms not published
Some packs include designer perfume oils

competitors.name: Ambiance by Talata
competitors.why_competitor: Woman-founded Ghanaian lifestyle and fragrance brand with vanilla and oud perfumes and free next-day Accra delivery.

hero_product.name: Be Mine - Vanilla & Shea Eau de Parfum (50ml + 10ml travel spray)

competitors.current_offer: Free sampler set with first purchase for email sign-up; free next-day delivery in Accra and Dubai.
strengths: Founder with a 41K personal following
Gifting, corporate and bespoke perfume-making revenue
Free next-day Accra delivery
Vanilla and chocolate-oud scents
Four-scent discovery set
weaknesses: USD pricing only
One perfume size
Perfume is secondary to home and body care
Focus shifting to Dubai
Small brand-account audience
